correctness.rationale: The derivative asymptotics make the critical product an admissible convex increasing composition. The fresh source criteria reduce the four regularity questions to explicit one-variable integrals. The Monge–Ampère integral is a generalized logarithmic integral with an exact lexicographic convergence test; the first-order square-integrable Sobolev integral has a strictly integrable power in complex dimension at least three; the endpoint second-order Sobolev integral diverges because the defining regularly varying function tends to infinity; and the integrable-Laplacian condition follows from vanishing derivative at infinity plus eventual concavity.
